summary: A 58-year-old woman fell ~40 feet to the ground rappelling The Bomb on Wind Tower when the rope pulled through the anchor; she suffered life-threatening injuries and died seven months later of complications; Rocky Mountain Rescue responded and she was flown out by helicopter.
location: The Bomb, Wind Tower, Eldorado Canyon
notes: ANAC 2023 edition (Pub 2023); incident Jun 22 per article; death ~7 months later from complications. | BCSO release corroborates: partner remained at the anchor and was assisted down with minor injuries; Medevac helicopter transport.
